diagnostic_signals.hdiutil_attach_error: Resource busy / superblock invalid (errno 5) at block 0

preceding_signals_72h.notes: YJ_MORE host had been disconnected and reattached during a write window; superblock written partial.

data_loss: none — MemoryVault SQLite reseeded from canonical store
lessons: Sparseimages on USB hosts that disconnect mid-write produce errno-5 superblock damage; always perform a hdiutil detach before sleep/eject.
Maintain a -v2 rebuild precedent per volume so recovery is mechanical, not creative.

diagnostic_signals.hdiutil_attach_error: Container superblock is invalid (reported, did not reproduce)

preceding_signals_72h.notes: Initial briefing claimed superblock invalid on /dev/disk21s1; follow-up attach hit /dev/disk20s1 cleanly. Likely a stale-slice probe right after host reconnect.

lessons: Errno 5 reported at session start MUST be debounced with at least one detach+reprobe cycle before triggering destructive recovery.
Track slice number across probes — same logical volume can appear at different /dev/diskN after stale-attach.
corruption_detector should return suggested_action='observe' (not 'rebuild') when only one probe reports errno 5 and Info.plist matches Info.bckup.

diagnostic_signals.hdiutil_attach_error: hdiutil attaches; diskutil mount fails — DIHLDiskImageAttach error 112 (no mountable file systems)

preceding_signals_72h.notes: Internal-hosted sparsebundle. Last clean unmount ~2026-06-05. fsck_apfs aborts at extent-ref-tree check; Apple does not ship an extent-ref rebuilder. Salvage via apfs-fuse declined (FUSE-3 ABI mismatch on macOS).

lessons: Extent-ref btree zeroing is the canonical signature of an interrupted band write that the APFS journal could not replay; unrecoverable with stock macOS tooling.
Pre-emptive defense: when DEVDRIVE detects a band's mtime within 60s of an unclean detach/unmount event, schedule a deep fsck on next mount.
Always preserve the corrupt bundle (rename, do not delete) until xz-archived to a different host — this incident's 7.2 GB band data is being relocated to YJ_MORE for cold-store reference.
apfs-fuse salvage is not viable on current macOS without a FUSE-3 system extension; do not promise the path until that ships.

preceding_signals_72h.notes: Not a corruption — fleet.json drives[id=920COWORK].image points at a path that does not exist on YJ_MORE, while host/host_path correctly identify internal location. Live mount served from internal copy.

recovery_outcome: lint-only (schema fix candidate; no volume action)
lessons: A v3 FleetRegistry.load() lint must reject or warn when drives[].host !== inferred-host-of(drives[].image). This entire incident class is preventable at parse time.
Do not classify a healthy-but-mis-declared volume as 'orphan' — investigate the live mount provenance via `hdiutil info` first.
Corruption detector must NOT recommend destructive action for this class; suggested_action='lint' is the correct terminal state.
